bar_trend.description:
Current 3 hour barometer trend with following definitions:
Rising Rapidly: bar_trend > =0.060
Rising Slowly: bar_trend >= 0.020
Steady: bar_trend < 0.020 and bar_trend > -0.020
Falling Slowly: bar_trend <= -0.020
Falling Rapidly: bar_trend <= -0.060
Not Available: bar_trend = null
